items.reminder: Ego has no place in working with your team.

quote.text: Pride is concerned with who is right. Humility is concerned with what is right.
quote.author: Ezra Taft Benson

items.action_focus: When presenting your circuit design today, ask for feedback from at least one team member before declaring it "done." Their input might catch something you missed—ego-free eyes see more.

items.reminder: Small habits compound into massive results.

quote.text: Habits are the compound interest of self-improvement. The same way that money multiplies through compound interest, the effects of your habits multiply as you repeat them.
quote.author: James Clear

items.action_focus: After finishing one task today, take 30 seconds to set up the next one. Leave yourself a note, open the file, prep the tool. Make starting easy tomorrow.

items.reminder: Always assume good intentions of others.

quote.text: We judge ourselves by our intentions and others by their behavior. Flip that script.
quote.author: Stephen Covey

items.action_focus: If someone pushes back on your idea today, mentally complete this sentence before responding: "They want to help by..." Then address that concern directly.
